GENERAL_FAST_BRANCH.as: the fast tier of its escalation ladder
GENERAL_FAST_BRANCH.why: Same capability, different cost point. A separate branch would duplicate every mapping and then have to be kept in sync with it.

HEAVY_REASONING_BRANCH.as: the heavy tier of its escalation ladder
HEAVY_REASONING_BRANCH.why: Escalation is a property of one responsibility, not a second one. Keeping them apart would mean the escalation target lived outside the branch that escalates.

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_BRANCH.why: software_engineering and coding are measured by the same suite on the same models, and every candidate ranks the same on both. Two branches over one body of evidence is fragmentation.

AUDIO_BRANCH.why: The only audio capabilities with a model behind them are speech-to-text and text-to-speech. audio_understanding has no model in any verified catalog, so an AUDIO branch would exist to hold a gap. The gap is recorded in Wave 4 where it belongs.

failures: DOCUMENT_OCR_BRANCH: DEGRADED - ocr measured, document_understanding has no measured path
FINANCE_ANALYSIS_BRANCH: no measured path for finance_analysis; never measured on any model: finance_analysis
CREATIVE_MULTIMODAL_BRANCH: no measured path for creative_writing, image_generation; never measured on any model: creative_writing, image_generation

scoring.role_score_is: the weakest required capability, never the mean
scoring.reputation_term: none; there is no field through which one could enter
scoring.saturated_suite: confidence in the ranking reduced, score left alone

note: A mapping here is derived from recorded runs and can move when a new run lands. A CAPABILITY_PROVIDER primary means the role has a path, not a local one, and never that the requested model is available.
